english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a literal ball of snow, including one used in a snowball fight.

examples.english: When it snowed, we had a snowball fight on the hillside and didn't want to leave.
examples.traditional: 落雪嗰陣，我哋喺山坡度掟雪球，玩到唔捨得走。
